derived_model.transformation: Fixed float32 input [1,43844,1]; selected note/onset/contour output order; into_typed then into_decluttered; canonical internal node names by evaluation order; preserved public input/output labels; deterministic write_to_tar_with_config(false,true). No quantization or training.
derived_model.determinism: Two independent converter processes produced identical SHA-256.

input_adapter.filter: 96-tap Blackman-windowed sinc, cutoff 0.94 of input Nyquist; compensated symmetric lookahead
input_adapter.time_mapping: Absolute source-window offset plus local 256-sample CQT frame center; midpoint interval boundaries; last interval ends at actual 16k PCM duration.

reproduce: See scripts/chord-model-converter; build-time tooling is separate from the mobile runtime dependency graph.
